name: Happy Earth

prices.note: One dress: Ruffle Wrap Dress | Monstera $98, sizes XXS/XS to 2XL/3XL. The store is mostly organic activewear, hoodies, sweatshirts and socks (product types on /products.json).

notes: Title: 'Happy Earth | Sustainable Clothing with Purpose'. Meta: 'Sustainable, eco-friendly clothing brand that gives back. Made Fair Trade with organic cotton. Inspired by nature and dedicated to preserving it.'
Our Story: founded while the founders were completing graduate degrees in biomedical sciences; started with tees dedicated to specific ecosystems; every purchase funded conservation. No year stated.
Shipping: free on orders over $150 to the contiguous US only; Alaska, Hawaii and territories standard $9.95. Returns: 30 days from delivery via the returns portal.
hq_country US: Good On You calls it 'a US organic clothing brand'; shipping is US-focused. No HQ city on pages read.
